runners_data.note: Recent winner at 15f on good (form: 1-8681) and trainer Karl Thornton has two runners in the last 14 days with no wins — hold-up style suits a strong gallop, but this trip at 2m1½f is a step up in stamina and should be watched on that count.|
runners_data.comment: Boxing Great arrives on the back of a win last time out and has prior experience of today's going, making him a live contender at 165 lb; the risk is that his three starts between those two victories show he can be inconsistent.

runners_data.name: Friary Road
runners_data.note: T M Walsh sends this one in from 33 days off, and the horse's sim-going numbers (13/15, 3W7P) are among the strongest in the field; a genuine deep hold-up runner whose style-fit of 0.93 means it will likely end up prominent today — if it does, that actually suits the contested-pace scenario.|
runners_data.comment: Friary Road has been placed in four of his last five starts, including a runner-up finish last time out, yet he remains winless in recent starts and a 33-day absence plus a hefty 163 lb to carry are factors to weigh against him here.

runners_data.name: Kimy
runners_data.note: Headgear flag (p) and a fading pattern in recent form (07296) raise stamina questions over this 2m1½f trip; Thomas Mullins's yard is 0/5 in the 14-day window and this horse has been competitive only at shorter distances recently.|
runners_data.comment: Kimy arrives on the back of a sixth last time out and a ninth two starts back, and with our figures ranking her ninth of eleven she looks a tough sell, though going experience and a return after just 12 days suggest she is at least fit and ready — yet to score in her last five starts.

runners_data.name: Jerandme
runners_data.note: A 12-year-old veteran (103 days off the track, form: 40730-) whose hold-up style leaves it reliant on a strong pace stringing the field out — the lengthy absence and age make it vulnerable to fitness questions on yielding ground over this marathon trip.|
runners_data.comment: Jerandme shaped with promise when third two starts back and, rated 81 on our figures, he represents a clear threat at this level despite carrying 162 lb; the main risk is a layoff of 103 days leaving his fitness open to question.

runners_data.name: Sequoiaspirit
runners_data.note: Won over 20f on soft (hist: 1/20f/SOF) and boasts the strongest all-conditions sim-going record in the race (15/15, 2W6P); style-fit 0.93 means it won't get its natural rear position today and could find itself tracking closer than ideal, though that may actually help if the pace is honest.|
runners_data.comment: Sequoiaspirit has been a model of consistency, finishing third, third, and second in three of his last four starts, and he has run over today's trip and going before; carrying 162 lb while yet to score in recent starts is the chief concern.

runners_data.name: Catalani
runners_data.note: Confirmed front-runner (style=L) with trainer Jack Foley in a decent T14 window (1/5); ran creditably at 23f on good last time out and the sim-going record is solid (7/8, 1W3P) — will set the standard up front but faces a direct challenge from Miss Gitana for the early lead.|
runners_data.comment: Catalani showed up with a third last time out after a run of fourths in recent starts, suggesting he finds a level without quite breaking through, and carrying 161 lb on a 19-day turnaround makes winning that bit harder still for a gelding yet to score in his last five.

runners_data.name: Day Trader
runners_data.note: Youngest horse in the field at 5, with a style-fit of 0.91 (lowest in the race among redistributed runners) — true hold-up profile mapped to midfield because of field congestion; two of its best efforts came on soft or yielding ground but the step up to 2m1½f is a significant ask.|
runners_data.comment: Day Trader has been winless in his last five starts, though that second last time out shows a degree of ability; carrying 161 lb is a stiff ask at this level, and he will need to improve on two unplaced efforts sandwiched around that run to make a real impact here.

runners_data.name: Cooley's Mist
runners_data.note: Ran just 5 days ago — the shortest turnaround in the field — and carries headgear (p); only 4 years old and its best form has come at 9f-13f, making this trip a major stamina question, and its style-fit of 0.93 suggests it won't get its preferred hold-up berth.|
runners_data.comment: Ranked tenth of eleven on our figures, Cooley's Mist is hard to fancy despite a win three starts back and a runner-up finish last time out; lightly weighted concerns aside, five days is a quick turnaround and his overall recent profile makes him difficult to support at this level.

runners_data.name: Miss Gitana
runners_data.note: Confirmed front-runner with the strongest sim-going record of any leader in the race (15/15, 1W5P) and solid form at 15f-16f on good ground; ran 10 days ago in decent form (098032) and will fight Catalani for the lead from the outset — the horse who wins that battle could be set up perfectly.|
runners_data.comment: Winless in her last six starts and ranked last on our figures, Miss Gitana faces a stiff ask here, though she has run over today's going before and back-to-back placed efforts on her last two starts at least hint at some residual form.

runners_data.name: Liberated Light
runners_data.note: Won at 16f on good ground and placed at the same trip (2W3P in sim-going, 13/15); a hold-up type whose style-fit of 0.94 is the highest redistribution fit in the field, meaning it is most likely of the closers to find a useful stalking position — trainer Kiely yard is 0/1 in the T14 window.|
runners_data.comment: Liberated Light has been winless in his last five starts but shaped with promise when second five starts back, and he returns on a quick turnaround of 18 days with going experience in his favour; at 155 lb, the weight ask is the chief concern for a horse rated 65 officially.

races.paceDynamic: Catalani and Miss Gitana are the two confirmed front-runners in this 11-runner field over 2m1½f at Bellewstown on yielding ground, and with both holding natural lead intentions, a genuine contested gallop from the outset is the most likely outcome rather than a dawdle. Catalani's trainer Jack Foley has a runner in form (T14: 1/5) and the horse has recent experience at this sort of trip, while Miss Gitana brings strong course-going suitability (15/15 in similar conditions) and will not surrender the rail without a fight. The honest, attritional pace over this stamina test on yielding ground will drain the field progressively, creating conditions that classically suit a well-placed prominent or midfield racer with proven staying ability rather than pure hold-up horses needing a late sprint. Several runners — Friary Road, Sequoiaspirit, Jerandme, Day Trader, Cooley's Mist, and Liberated Light — are genuine hold-up types pushed forward on the pace map because the field contains more closers than the track can accommodate at the rear; of these, Friary Road (style-fit 0.93, strong sim-going record) and Sequoiaspirit (2W in similar conditions) are best-placed to actually secure a forward position if they press their claims early.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Contested Pace, Stayer Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Catalani and Miss Gitana push each other through an honest gallop and the field strings out on the yielding ground, setting it up for a relentless stayer to pounce.
scenarios.body: The two leaders burn each other up over the final mile, and the horse best able to sustain rhythm over 2m1½f on soft ground runs them down approaching the final bend; Friary Road's proven staying profile (3W7P in similar going, sim-going 13/15) and Sequoiaspirit's prior win over 20f on soft make them ideally suited.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Leader Dictates Unchallenged
scenarios.trigger: If Miss Gitana or Catalani gets a soft lead and the opposition fails to apply early pressure, allowing a front-runner to control the tempo.
scenarios.body: One leader settles in front with the other tucking in behind rather than fighting, producing a falsely moderate gallop that rewards the horse who dictates; Miss Gitana's excellent sim-going record (15/15) and proven front-running at this trip make her the natural beneficiary if she seizes control.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Racer Slots Through
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuine but not brutal, and a prominent-tracking runner saves enough energy to win a sprint to the line.
scenarios.body: A horse travelling comfortably just off the two leaders finds the gaps opening as the front-runners tire in the final quarter-mile; Boxing Great (1W on good, strong recent form string 1-8681) or Baltic Bird could track into a winning position from off the pace.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Swoops Late
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is ferocious enough to completely empty the field, leaving a genuine closer to pick up the pieces in the final furlong.
scenarios.body: With so many redistributed hold-up types unable to get their natural position, this scenario is less likely than it appears; however, if the gallop is truly brutal, Baltic Bird (sim-going 15/15, proven at 22f-25f on good) has the stamina profile to finish best of all.

watchPoints.text: Miss Gitana and Catalani — watch the first half-mile closely: if neither concedes and they lock horns at a fierce gallop, the entire race shape tilts toward closers and stayers; if one blinks early, the other controls the race.|

Friary Road — despite being a true hold-up type, its sim-going dominance (13/15, 3W7P) and style-fit mean it may actively seek a prominent position today; if Friary Road presses forward from the outset, it becomes a serious danger in the contested-pace scenario.|

Cooley's Mist — only 5 days since its last run and the trip at 2m1½f is far beyond its winning distance range; monitor whether it weakens sharply in the final half-mile, as that will set the tempo benchmark for the closers.|

Jerandme — 103 days off the track for a 12-year-old on yielding ground; if it travels fluently in the early stages despite the layoff it signals the pace may not be strong enough to string out the field, which would alter the dynamic for all hold-up horses.|

Sequoiaspirit — its previous win over 20f on soft (1/20f/SOF) is the most relevant form line in the race for this trip and going; watch where jockey Mr L Hackett elects to position it — if it goes forward early rather than settling at the rear, it could be the dark shape of the race.|
